mapper.select:
/* BmsMobBwstMapper.selectInitStockScanInfo : 재고실사 - 재고PKG SCAN 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN ISNULL(SCAN_START_TIME, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(SCAN_END_TIME, '') <> '' THEN 'S' WHEN ISNULL(SCAN_END_TIME, '') <> '' THEN 'E' WHEN ISNULL(SCAN_END_TIME, '') = '' AND ISNULL(SCAN_START_TIME, '') <> '' THEN 'C' ELSE 'S' END AS STATUS FROM TB_BMS_STOCK_SCAN_START_END WHERE
SCAN_END_TIME = '' ORDER BY SEQ DESC

/* BmsMobBwstMapper.selectScanLogInfo : 재고실사 스캔 로그 조회 */
SELECT IN_PLAN_NO , SCAN_NO , BL_NO , PACKING_NO , SCAN_DATE , SCAN_TIME , SCAN_RESULT , SCAN_CT , REGISTER_USER_ID , ISNULL((SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = tbsps.REGISTER_USER_ID),'') AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , REGISTER_DATE_TIME FROM TB_BMS_STOCK_PKG_SCAN tbsps WHERE SCAN_DATE + ' ' + SCAN_TIME >= #{scanStartDateTime}

/* BmsMobBwstMapper.selectRealStockCarryInDetail : 재고실사처리 - 반입 조회 */
SELECT TOP 1 I.OD_JOB_NO, I.BL_NO, ISNULL(S.SCAN_CT, 1) AS SCAN_CT, /* SCAN 수량 */ SUBSTRING(I.CARRYIN_DATE+ ' ' + I.CARRYIN_TIME, 3, LEN(I.CARRYIN_DATE+ ' ' + I.CARRYIN_TIME)) AS CARRYIN_DATE_TIME, /* 반입일시 */ CASE WHEN ISNULL(S.SEQ, '') != '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS APPLY_YN /* 적용여부 */ FROM TB_BMS_IN I WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_STOCK_SCAN S ON I.BL_NO = S.BL_NO WHERE I.IN_NO = #{srchNo}

/* BmsMobBwstMapper.selectLocationInfoDetail : 로케이션적치 - 로케이션정보 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 CODE AS CODE , NAME_DEFAULT AS NAME FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL LOC WHERE LOC.GROUP_CODE = 'WH_LOCATION' AND LOC.CODE = #{locationPlace}

/* BmsMobBwstMapper.selectScanLogInfoByLocation : 적치된 재고실사 스캔 로그 조회 */ SELECT p.IN_PLAN_NO, p.BL_NO, p.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, p.OD_JOB_NO, pkg.PACKING_NO, pkg.LOCATION_STATUS, pkg.LOCATION_PLACE, pkg.OUT_CT AS PKG_OUT_CT, pkg.DELETE_YN, carryIn.IN_NO AS IN_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG pkg WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN p WITH (NOLOCK) ON pkg.IN_PLAN_NO = p.IN_PLAN_NO INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN carryIn WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = carryIn.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO WHERE pkg.LOCATION_PLACE = #{locationPlace} AND pkg.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND carryIn.STOCK_CT > 0

/* BmsMobBwstMapper.selectPkgWithLogByLocation : 로케이션에 적치된 박스와 스캔 로그 조회 */ SELECT p.IN_PLAN_NO, p.BL_NO, p.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, p.OD_JOB_NO, pkg.PACKING_NO, pkg.LOCATION_STATUS, pkg.OUT_CT AS PKG_OUT_CT, pkg.DELETE_YN, ISNULL(pkgScan.SCAN_RESULT, '') AS SCAN_RESULT FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG pkg WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN p WITH (NOLOCK) ON pkg.IN_PLAN_NO = p.IN_PLAN_NO INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN carryIn WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = carryIn.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 SCAN_RESULT FROM TB_BMS_STOCK_PKG_SCAN scan WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE scan.PACKING_NO = pkg.PACKING_NO ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC ) pkgScan WHERE pkg.LOCATION_PLACE = #{locationPlace} AND pkg.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND carryIn.STOCK_CT > 0

/* BmsMobBwstMapper.selectStockInfoByLocation : 적치된 재고PKG SCAN 조회 */ SELECT p.IN_PLAN_NO, p.BL_NO, p.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, p.OD_JOB_NO, pkg.PACKING_NO, pkg.LOCATION_STATUS, pkg.LOCATION_PLACE, pkg.DELETE_YN FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG pkg WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN p WITH (NOLOCK) ON pkg.IN_PLAN_NO = p.IN_PLAN_NO WHERE pkg.PACKING_NO = #{packingNo}
AND pkg.SEQ = #{srchSeq}

/* BmsMobBwstMapper.selectCurrentStockScanSeq_old : 현재 재고실사SCAN 차수 가져오기 */ SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(STOCK_SCAN_SEQ) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(STOCK_SCAN_SEQ) + 1 ELSE 1 END FROM TB_BMS_STOCK_SCAN_START_END WHERE SCAN_DATE <= CONVERT(CHAR(10), GETDATE(), 23) AND SCAN_END_DATE >= CONVERT(CHAR(10), GETDATE(), 23) AND SCAN_START_TIME <= CONVERT(CHAR(10), GETDATE(), 24)

/* BmsMobBwstMapper.checkScannedByScanDate : 현재 재고실사SCAN 차수 가져오기 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BMS_STOCK_PKG_SCAN pkgScan JOIN TB_BMS_STOCK_SCAN_START_END SSSE ON SSSE.SCAN_END_DATE = '' AND pkgScan.SCAN_DATE = SSSE.SCAN_DATE AND pkgScan.SCAN_DATE + ' ' + pkgScan.SCAN_TIME >= SSSE.SCAN_DATE + ' ' + SSSE.SCAN_START_TIME

/* BmsMobBwstMapper.getStockScanStartEnd : 재고실사 - 재고PKG SCAN 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 SCAN_DATE , SCAN_START_TIME FROM TB_BMS_STOCK_SCAN_START_END WHERE
SCAN_END_TIME = '' ORDER BY SEQ DESC
